description:
FILED s464ay (Opus, round 22 review), found while probing #1025 in the same
lowering.  PRE-EXISTING.  Loud, but it kills the WHOLE FILE, so every row
after it is lost -- the failure mode the audit plan (docs/plan-test-audit-s464.md
phase 1) calls "the file's FIRST error kills every row".

REPRO (scratch/p36-sse-range.pl, line 3):

    my $z = 'X';
    $z =~ s/X/join ':', map { $_ } 1 .. 3/e;
    print "[$z]\n";

  perl 5.40.3:  [1:2:3]
  PCL:          Transpile failed:
                PCL: cannot compile the s///e replacement
                'join ':', map { $_ } 1 .. 3':
                PCL internal: no form emitter for expression node type 'anon_sub'

The message names the cause precisely: the replacement is compiled by a
restricted expression path that has no emitter for a block argument, so any
`map`/`grep`/`sort` BLOCK form -- an extremely ordinary thing to write in a
replacement -- is a hard transpile error.  `map` OUTSIDE an s///e is fine, and
the paren form should be checked (`map({$_} 1..3)` and `map(subâ¦)`) to see how
narrow the hole is; that measurement is the first step.

RELATED: #1025 -- the same replacement lowering gives `..` scalar (flip-flop)
context.  Two defects in one path, so they are probably one fix session:
give the s///e replacement the ordinary expression compiler and the ordinary
context, rather than the restricted one it has.

NOT MEASURED YET: how many corpus/suite files carry this shape.  Do that
before sizing -- `tools/drop-census.pl` will not see it (this is a transpile
FAILURE, not a dropped statement), so grep the four populations for
`s/.../...map/e` and friends and count the files that die.

DONE (s526w1, 2026-10-24, commit "s526w1 filler: #1026" on branch worktree-agent-a8804ba6e7379e0f6): `_try_compile_subst_e` (Pl/ExprToCL.pm) built its PExpr WITHOUT the enclosing statement's parser, so every block in a replacement (anon sub, map/grep/sort block, do-block) stayed an `anon_sub` node that no form emitter takes and the whole file failed to transpile.  Now the replacement's PExpr is handed the parser, so embedded blocks are compiled the ordinary way.  Unblocked TimeDate's Date/Format.pm:65 (TimeDate 4 files 0 rows -> 509/0 = perl).  Bars: corpus-diff IDENTICAL over 111; emission-ab lib 56 SAME; no generation bump (output changes only for inputs that failed to transpile).  Guard Pl/t/regexp-subst-01.t (+2, perl oracle row).
subject: A `map { â¦ }` (or any anon-sub-shaped block) inside an `s///e` REPLACEMENT fails the whole TRANSPILE: "PCL: cannot compile the s///e replacement â¦ no form emitter for expression node type 'anon_sub'"
